units.title: Exact cosine-frame Gram identities
units.reader_note: Conditions, formula steps and exact Lean open beside the concise claim. The complete private Gaussian application is at step6.
units.statement: The half-grid cosine frame has orthogonal columns with squared norm d, zero weighted Gram at frequency2q+1, and row sum of squares at most2(q+1).
assumptions: \(d,q\) are natural numbers with \(2q+1<d\). This includes \(q=0\) and implies \(d\ge2\).
For zero-based \(i=0,\ldots,d-1\), put \(\theta_i=(i+1/2)\pi/d\). The frame has \(r=q+1\) columns: \(T_{i0}=1\) and \(T_{ik}=\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i)\) for \(1\le k\le q\).
\(D_{2q+1}=\operatorname{diag}(\cos((2q+1)\theta_i))\). Transpose, matrix multiplication and row sum of squares are real Euclidean operations.

In the private application, \(\mu=N(0,I_{d r})\) is the actual centered Gaussian on coordinates \((i,a)\), and \(B(x)_{i,(a,b)}=d^{-1/2}x_{(i,a)}T_{ib}\). Its moments and Gram-entry integrability are conclusions derived internally.

steps.title: Cancel the half-grid cosine modes
steps.text: Apply the existing exact integer-frequency midpoint alias. Below the first nonzero alias frequency, a nonzero mode sums to zero; the zero mode sums to d. Divisibility and the strict frequency bounds are proved inside the argument.
steps.lean:
have hd : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  have hqd : 2 * (q : ℤ) + 1 < (d : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hmode (k : ℤ) (hlo : -(2 * (d : ℤ)) < k) (hhi : k < 2 * (d : ℤ)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, C k i) = if k = 0 then (d : ℝ) else 0 := by
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · subst k
      simp [C]
    · have hnd : ¬ (2 * (d : ℤ)) ∣ k := by
        intro hdiv
        by_cases hk : 0 ≤ k
        · exact hk0 (Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt hk hhi hdiv)
        · have hz := Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt
            (show 0 ≤ -k by omega) (show -k < 2 * (d : ℤ) by omega)
            (dvd_neg.mpr hdiv)
          omega
      simpa [C, θ, hnd, hk0] using
        (AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumGridAlias.actual_midpoint_grid_cosine_alias hd k)
  have hzero (k : ℤ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk1 : k < 2 * (d : ℤ)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, C k i) = 0 := by
    rw [hmode k (by omega) hk1, if_neg (ne_of_gt hk0)]

steps.title: Normalize the ordinary Gram
steps.text: Expand products into sum and difference frequencies. The constant column has coefficient1; positive cosine columns have coefficient sqrt2. Only equal column indices leave a zero mode, giving exactly d on the diagonal. The same product identity prepares the weighted calculation.
steps.lean:
have hprod (a b : ℤ) (i : Fin d) :
      C a i * C b i = (C (a - b) i + C (a + b) i) / 2 := by
    dsimp only [C]
    rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_add, sub_mul, add_mul]
    nlinarith [Real.two_mul_cos_mul_cos ((a : ℝ) * θ i) ((b : ℝ) * θ i)]
  have hpair (a b : ℤ) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, C a i * C b i) =
        ((∑ i : Fin d, C (a - b) i) + (∑ i : Fin d, C (a + b) i)) / 2 := by
    simp_rw [hprod]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have htriple (a b : ℤ) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, C n i * (C a i * C b i)) =
        (((∑ i : Fin d, C (n - (a - b)) i) + (∑ i : Fin d, C (n + (a - b)) i)) +
          ((∑ i : Fin d, C (n - (a + b)) i) + (∑ i : Fin d, C (n + (a + b)) i))) / 4 := by
    have hp (i : Fin d) : C n i * (C a i * C b i) =
        ((C (n - (a - b)) i + C (n + (a - b)) i) +
          (C (n - (a + b)) i + C (n + (a + b)) i)) / 4 := by
      calc
        _ = (C n i * C (a - b) i + C n i * C (a + b) i) / 2 := by
          rw [hprod a b i]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hprod n (a - b) i, hprod n (a + b) i]; ring
    simp_rw [hp]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have ht (i : Fin d) (j : Fin (q + 1)) : t i j = c j * C (j.val : ℤ) i := by
    by_cases hj : j.val = 0
    · simp only [t, c, if_pos hj, C, hj, Int.natCast_zero, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul,
        Real.cos_zero, one_mul]
    · simp only [t, c, if_neg hj, C, Int.cast_natCast]
  have hjbound (j : Fin (q + 1)) : (j.val : ℤ) ≤ (q : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show j.val ≤ q by omega)
  have hgram (j k : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k) = if j = k then (d : ℝ) else 0 := by
    have hs : (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k) =
        c j * c k * (((∑ i : Fin d, C ((j.val : ℤ) - k.val) i) +
          (∑ i : Fin d, C ((j.val : ℤ) + k.val) i)) / 2) := by
      calc
        _ = c j * c k * (∑ i : Fin d, C (j.val : ℤ) i * C (k.val : ℤ) i) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [ht, ht]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hpair]
    rw [hs, hmode _ (by have := hjbound j; have := hjbound k; omega)
      (by have := hjbound j; have := hjbound k; omega),
      hmode _ (by omega) (by have := hjbound j; have := hjbound k; omega)]
    by_cases heq : j = k
    · subst k
      simp only [sub_self, ite_true]
      by_cases hj : j.val = 0
      · simp only [c, if_pos hj, hj, Int.natCast_zero, zero_add, ite_true,
          one_mul, add_self_div_two]
      · have hsum : (j.val : ℤ) + j.val ≠ 0 := by omega
        rw [if_neg hsum]
        simp only [c, if_neg hj, add_zero]
        have hsqrt : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = (2 : ℝ) := by
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
        rw [hsqrt]
        ring
    · have hdiff : (j.val : ℤ) - k.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply heq
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
      have hsum : (j.val : ℤ) + k.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply heq
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
      simp [heq, hdiff, hsum]

steps.title: Remove every weighted mode
steps.text: With n=2q+1, each of the four frequencies n plus or minus j plus or minus k is positive and less than2d. This includes the constant-column cases. Every weighted entry therefore vanishes. The exact source condition2q+1<d supplies all bounds.
steps.lean:
have hweighted (j k : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, C n i * (C (j.val : ℤ) i * C (k.val : ℤ) i)) = 0 := by
    rw [htriple]
    have hj := hjbound j
    have hk := hjbound k
    have hf1 := hzero (n - ((j.val : ℤ) - k.val)) (by dsimp [n]; omega) (by dsimp [n]; omega)
    have hf2 := hzero (n + ((j.val : ℤ) - k.val)) (by dsimp [n]; omega) (by dsimp [n]; omega)
    have hf3 := hzero (n - ((j.val : ℤ) + k.val)) (by dsimp [n]; omega) (by dsimp [n]; omega)
    have hf4 := hzero (n + ((j.val : ℤ) + k.val)) (by dsimp [n]; omega) (by dsimp [n]; omega)
    rw [hf1, hf2, hf3, hf4]
    norm_num
  change t.transpose * t = (d : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) ∧
    t.transpose * D * t = 0 ∧
    ∀ i : Fin d, ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ((q : ℝ) + 1)
  constructor
  · ext j k
    change (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k) = (d : ℝ) * (if j = k then 1 else 0)
    simpa only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] using hgram j k
  constructor
  · ext j k
    change (∑ i : Fin d, (t.transpose * D) j i * t i k) = 0
    have hm (i : Fin d) : (t.transpose * D) j i = t i j * C n i := by
      simp [D, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply, C, n]
    simp_rw [hm, ht]
    calc
      _ = c j * c k * (∑ i : Fin d, C n i * (C (j.val : ℤ) i * C (k.val : ℤ) i)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hweighted]; ring

steps.title: Bound each row
steps.text: The constant coordinate contributes1. Each of the q positive cosine coordinates contributes at most2 because its cosine square is at most1. This proves the stated bound, also when q=0.
steps.lean:
· intro i
    have hb (k : Fin (q + 1)) : (t i k) ^ 2 ≤ if k.val = 0 then 1 else 2 := by
      by_cases hk : k.val = 0
      · simp only [t, if_pos hk, one_pow, le_refl]
      · simp only [t, if_neg hk, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
        nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_le_one ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (if k.val = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hb k)
      _ = 1 + 2 * (q : ℝ) := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]; simp [mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 2 * ((q : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith

steps.title: Obtain moments from the actual Gaussian law
steps.text: For the literal identity-covariance Gaussian, canonical Gaussian L2 facts give integrability of coordinate products. The actual vector mean is zero and coordinate covariance is the identity. The d to the minus one-half normalization is derived from d>0, rather than supplied as a certificate.
steps.lean:
have hL2 (u : I) : MemLp (fun x : E => x u) 2 μ :=
    IsGaussian.memLp_dual μ (EuclideanSpace.proj u) 2 (by simp)
  have hmean (u : I) : (∫ x : E, x u ∂μ) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (EuclideanSpace.proj u) (∫ x : E, x ∂μ) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) u).integral_comp_comm
          (μ := μ) (φ := fun x : E => x) IsGaussian.integrable_fun_id
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [show (∫ x : E, x ∂μ) = (0 : E) from integral_id_multivariateGaussian]
        exact map_zero _
  have hxyint (u v : I) : Integrable (fun x : E => x u * x v) μ :=
    (hL2 u).integrable_mul (hL2 v)
  have hxymean (u v : I) :
      (∫ x : E, x u * x v ∂μ) = if u = v then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    have h := covariance_eval_multivariateGaussian (μ := (0 : E))
      (S := (1 : Matrix I I ℝ)) Matrix.PosSemidef.one u v
    change covariance (fun x : E => x u) (fun x : E => x v) μ =
      (if u = v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) at h
    simpa only [covariance, hmean, sub_zero] using h
  have hdpos : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hscale : scale ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) = 1 := by
    dsimp only [scale]
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hdpos)

steps.title: Center the actual random Gram matrices
steps.text: Expand both Gram entries as finite sums of integrable coordinate products. Interchange each finite sum and integral, then use the two proved frame identities. Every entry is integrable, the ordinary mean is the identity and the weighted mean is zero. The complete private application is folded here.
steps.lean:
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumCosineGram
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Multivariate

open Matrix MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

/-! Actual Gaussian Gram integrability and means consume the cosine-frame identities.
No independent/moment/Gram or integrability certificate is supplied by the caller;
range/Krylov, concentration, oracle/cap/cost and full lower bounds are separate. -/
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumCosineGram

private theorem actual_gaussian_gram_means {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i))
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1))) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)))
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  let B : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) →
      Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun x i a =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * WithLp.ofLp x (i, a.1) * t i a.2
  ∀ a b : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1),
    Integrable (fun x => ((B x).transpose * B x) a b) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b) μ ∧
    (∫ x, ((B x).transpose * B x) a b ∂μ) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∫ x, ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b ∂μ) = 0
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let I := Fin d × Fin (q + 1)
  let J := Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ I
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal w
  let μ : Measure E := multivariateGaussian (0 : E) (1 : Matrix I I ℝ)
  let scale : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹
  let B : E → Matrix (Fin d) J ℝ := fun x i a => scale * x (i, a.1) * t i a.2
  have hframe :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumCosineGram.actual_cosine_frame_gram hq
  change t.transpose * t = (d : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) ∧
    t.transpose * D * t = 0 ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ((q : ℝ) + 1)) at hframe
  have hgram (j k : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k) = if j = k then (d : ℝ) else 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ => M j k) hframe.1
    change (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k) = (d : ℝ) * (if j = k then 1 else 0) at h
    simpa only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] using h
  have hweighted (j k : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∑ i : Fin d, t i j * w i * t i k) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ => M j k) hframe.2.1
    change (∑ i : Fin d, (t.transpose * D) j i * t i k) = 0 at h
    simpa only [D, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  have hL2 (u : I) : MemLp (fun x : E => x u) 2 μ :=
    IsGaussian.memLp_dual μ (EuclideanSpace.proj u) 2 (by simp)
  have hmean (u : I) : (∫ x : E, x u ∂μ) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (EuclideanSpace.proj u) (∫ x : E, x ∂μ) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) u).integral_comp_comm
          (μ := μ) (φ := fun x : E => x) IsGaussian.integrable_fun_id
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [show (∫ x : E, x ∂μ) = (0 : E) from integral_id_multivariateGaussian]
        exact map_zero _
  have hxyint (u v : I) : Integrable (fun x : E => x u * x v) μ :=
    (hL2 u).integrable_mul (hL2 v)
  have hxymean (u v : I) :
      (∫ x : E, x u * x v ∂μ) = if u = v then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    have h := covariance_eval_multivariateGaussian (μ := (0 : E))
      (S := (1 : Matrix I I ℝ)) Matrix.PosSemidef.one u v
    change covariance (fun x : E => x u) (fun x : E => x v) μ =
      (if u = v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) at h
    simpa only [covariance, hmean, sub_zero] using h
  have hdpos : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hscale : scale ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) = 1 := by
    dsimp only [scale]
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hdpos)
  have hf (a b : J) : (fun x : E => ((B x).transpose * B x) a b) =
      (fun x : E => ∑ i : Fin d, (scale ^ 2 * (t i a.2 * t i b.2)) *
        (x (i, a.1) * x (i, b.1))) := by
    funext x
    change (∑ i : Fin d, B x i a * B x i b) = _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp only [B]
    ring
  have hfw (a b : J) : (fun x : E => ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b) =
      (fun x : E => ∑ i : Fin d, (scale ^ 2 * (t i a.2 * w i * t i b.2)) *
        (x (i, a.1) * x (i, b.1))) := by
    funext x
    change (∑ i : Fin d, ((B x).transpose * D) a i * B x i b) = _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [D, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    change (scale * x (i, a.1) * t i a.2) * w i *
      (scale * x (i, b.1) * t i b.2) = _
    ring
  change ∀ a b : J,
    Integrable (fun x : E => ((B x).transpose * B x) a b) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x : E => ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b) μ ∧
    (∫ x : E, ((B x).transpose * B x) a b ∂μ) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∫ x : E, ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b ∂μ) = 0
  intro a b
  have hi (i : Fin d) : Integrable (fun x : E =>
      (scale ^ 2 * (t i a.2 * t i b.2)) * (x (i, a.1) * x (i, b.1))) μ :=
    (hxyint (i, a.1) (i, b.1)).const_mul _
  have hwi (i : Fin d) : Integrable (fun x : E =>
      (scale ^ 2 * (t i a.2 * w i * t i b.2)) * (x (i, a.1) * x (i, b.1))) μ :=
    (hxyint (i, a.1) (i, b.1)).const_mul _
  have hdelta (i : Fin d) : (if (i, a.1) = (i, b.1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (if a.1 = b.1 then 1 else 0) := by simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hf]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)
  · rw [hfw]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hwi i)
  · rw [hf, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul, hxymean, hdelta]
    calc
      _ = (if a.1 = b.1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * scale ^ 2 *
          (∑ i : Fin d, t i a.2 * t i b.2) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hgram]
        by_cases h1 : a.1 = b.1
        · by_cases h2 : a.2 = b.2
          · have heq : a = b := Prod.ext h1 h2
            simp only [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_pos heq, one_mul]
            exact hscale
          · have hne : a ≠ b := fun h => h2 (congrArg Prod.snd h)
            simp [h1, h2, hne]
        · have hne : a ≠ b := fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h)
          simp [h1, hne]
  · rw [hfw, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hwi i)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul, hxymean, hdelta]
    calc
      _ = (if a.1 = b.1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * scale ^ 2 *
          (∑ i : Fin d, t i a.2 * w i * t i b.2) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hweighted]; ring

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumCosineGram
